# Cole Sustain Timmy — AI-first FullStack Developer

> Personal portfolio and case studies for Cole Sustain Timmy (devTimmy), a full-stack developer building practical web and mobile applications with AI.

## About

Cole Sustain Timmy is an AI-first full-stack developer based in Nigeria. He builds production-ready web and mobile apps using Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, and AI tooling.

- Twitter/X: https://x.com/_devTimmy
- GitHub: https://github.com/devtimmy
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/devtimmy

## Projects

### FilmSort
An offline-first Android media organizer app. Built with React Native, featuring a local video player, barcode scanner, multi-profile support, and watch-party functionality.
- Case study: https://solo-devtimmy.vercel.app/filmsort-case-study

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
- Frontend: Next.js, React, React Native, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express
- Tools: Expo, EAS Build, Git, Vercel
